## Lesson map

Extending the probability measures to countable additivity (sigma algebra)

- 2:47 Sigma algebra generated by an algebra (something new)
- 7:07 Infimum & Supremum of the set are essentially just min and max which may or may not be in the set
- 8:43 Infimum = greatest lower bound, Supremum = least upper bound (which may or may not be in the set)
- 16:05 17:28 Outer measure (P*) associated with a Probability measure (17:55 not a probability measure itself, but it does behave like a Prob measure cause its many similar properties) 30:30
- 21:55 Countable subadditivity property for the Outer measure, and its long proof
